public.text: The discussion distinguishes required services from mandatory support, but does not address conditional requirements whose applicability depends on a selected option, jurisdiction, use case, or maturity level.
public.suggestedRevision: Add a conditional status, with machine-readable applicability criteria and an obligation to document why a conditional requirement is or is not applicable.
